theme: Tìm hiểu văn hoá công ty

vocab.example_vi: Anh/chị có thể mô tả công việc hàng ngày của vị trí này không?

vocab.example: How would you describe the working atmosphere in your team?
vocab.example_vi: Anh/chị mô tả bầu không khí làm việc trong nhóm mình thế nào?

vocab.example: Everyone can speak up, even in front of the director.
vocab.example_vi: Mọi người đều có thể mạnh dạn nêu ý kiến, kể cả trước mặt giám đốc.

listening.title: A candidate asks about the working atmosphere

lines.speaker: Hoa (Interviewer)
lines.text: Nam, we have ten minutes left. Do you have any questions for us?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes. Could you describe the day-to-day work of this position?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Interviewer)
lines.text: You would spend most mornings on code, and afternoons on reviews and meetings.

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: That sounds balanced. How would you describe the working atmosphere here?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Interviewer)
lines.text: We are quite informal. Everyone can speak up, even in front of the director.

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: I like that. Do you follow a hybrid model, or is everyone in the office?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Interviewer)
lines.text: Three days in the office, two days at home, and working hours are flexible.

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Is there a mentoring program for someone who joins a new domain?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Interviewer)
lines.text: Yes. Every new engineer gets a senior partner for the first three months.

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: That is very helpful. Is the dress code formal, or can I wear jeans?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Interviewer)
lines.text: Jeans are fine. Our only team ritual is breakfast together every Monday morning.

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Thank you. Everything you described matches the kind of team I am looking for.

questions.q: What does the candidate ask about first?
How many days do most teams work in the office?
What team ritual does the interviewer mention?

shadowing: Could you tell me more about the day-to-day work of this role?
In my last team, I always spoke up when I saw a risk.
I worked in a hybrid model for two years and stayed very productive.
I joined a mentoring program last year and it improved my testing skills.
A working atmosphere where people share problems early is very important to me.
